acceptedContractSignatures.checkImageStorageExistsNote: CORRECTED 2026-08-03 (see statusCorrection below). As originally merged this method carried an additional optional trailing fileExistsForTest parameter, which was signature drift from the accepted 1-argument contract despite being optional/defaulted/test-only. Fixed by moving the test override to a module-private variable settable only via the separately-named, non-accepted-contract export __setImagingStorageExistenceCheckerForTest. The method now matches the accepted signature exactly.

tenantEnforcement.getImagesForLifecycleReview: clinicId and patientId both applied in the Prisma where clause (flat column + relation)

imageIdOnlyMethods.mechanism: ownership re-derivation via ImagingImage -> ImagingStudy -> clinicId before every read/mutation; fail-closed indistinguishable ImagingNotFoundError on any mismatch or missing traversal; mutation where-clauses re-scoped by the derived clinicId; imageId provenance is only ever obtainable via the clinicId-scoped getImagesForLifecycleReview query
imageIdOnlyMethods.regressionVsCurrentDirectCallers: strictly stronger — current callers (markConfirmedMissing, redactPatientImagingImages) perform zero re-check at the point of mutation
imageIdOnlyMethods.CORRECTED_2026_08_03: This entire block describes a data-integrity consistency check (does ImagingImage.clinicId agree with its own ImagingStudy.clinicId), NOT caller tenant authorization. No field in this block is compared against any caller-supplied value — none of the three imageId-only methods' accepted signatures carry one. blockedTenantContextContractInsufficientTriggered is corrected to true as of this update. See statusCorrection.tenantAuthorizationGap below and the evidence doc's §26.1.

findings.title: Tenant authorization is not enforced for the three imageId-only methods
findings.summary: findOwnedImage() checks ImagingImage.clinicId against its own ImagingStudy.clinicId — a data-integrity consistency check, not caller tenant authorization. No caller-supplied clinicId/principal/context exists anywhere in the accepted signatures of markStorageMissing, redactForAnonymization, or checkImageStorageExists to check the resolved clinicId against.

findings.title: checkImageStorageExists shipped with signature drift from the accepted contract
findings.summary: Accepted signature is (imageId: string): Promise<boolean>. Implementation added an optional trailing fileExistsForTest parameter, which is a public contract change regardless of being optional/defaulted/test-only.
findings.fix: Removed the parameter. checkImageStorageExists is now exactly (imageId: string): Promise<boolean>. Test-only failure injection moved to a module-private variable settable only via the separate, non-accepted-contract export __setImagingStorageExistenceCheckerForTest(override).
